description: This PHP source file defines the ResourceServer class within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 middleware, handling OAuth2 resource server validation, user retrieval, and request authorization logic.

classes.name: ResourceServer
classes.description: Middleware class for OAuth2 resource server validation and user context setting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ResourceServer with an OAuthResourceServer instance.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, validates OAuth2 tokens unless exempt, and sets the current user globally.

methods.name: setCurrentUserGlobal
methods.description: Sets the global current_user variable after validating user activity status.

methods.name: getUserFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the user associated with the OAuth2 request, falling back to client user if necessary.
